newsitem.title: UK: Wasps help give age of ancient rock art.
newsitem.headline: Wasps help give age of ancient rock art.

text.p: Wasp nests can help archaeologists determine just how old ancient cave paintings are, Australian researchers said on Wednesday.
They said they had used the fossilised nests of mud dauber wasps, built underneath and on top of aboriginal rock paintings, to date the paintings.

"Optical dating of quartz sand embedded in the mud of fossilised nests shows that some anthropomorphic paintings are more than 17,000 years old," Richard Roberts of La Trobe University in Melbourne and colleagues reported in the science journal Nature.
